title: Mallworld creeping into my creative process
content: I'm a visual artist and somewhat of a writer, and have noticed imagery and ideas from our shared dreamscape creeping into my work. Has anybody else had this happen? Example: I came to in a parking lot Lights humming like a hive Escalators breathing slow Selling pieces of my life Saints behind the glass display Smiling like they know my name Every door says almost home Every hallway looks the same Welcome to Mallworld Open twenty four seven Buy a future, trade your past Keep your fear as a weapon In Mallworld Everything shines and rots You can lose yourself forever Or wake up to what you got Food court prayers and broken vows Sound bleeding through the walls Security with empty eyes Watching nothing as it falls Something's watching back at me Through glass, through space and time I hear footsteps call my name But they never seem to find Welcome to Mallworld Where the ceiling never ends You can rent a better version Of the life you can't defend In Mallworld Hope is always on sale cheap But the signs keep changing places And the doors won't let you leave There's a train beneath the floors Still running through my head If I follow far enough I might find my way instead Welcome to Mallworld Where the false pretends it's real You can drown in all the choices Or remember how to feel In Mallworld The lie is dressed as truth But there's a crack in every ceiling If you're brave enough to move
